MOJO AI Summits

Privacy Policy

Last updated July 27, 2026.

Information We Collect

When you submit a member or guest registration, MOJO AI Summits collects the information you provide, including your name, company, title, industry, company email address, mobile phone number, event role, food preferences, and publication-use preferences for your name and company. We may also record phone verification status for account validation and event operations.

How We Use Information

We use registration information to review invitations, validate attendee accounts, coordinate member and guest event logistics, and communicate about MOJO AI Summits. SMS from the registration flow is used only to send one-time verification codes requested by the user.

If you opt in, we may use your name and company in artifacts built for publication. Title and industry are collected for event context, segmentation, and planning.

SMS Verification

If you select Verify Phone, MOJO AI Summits may send a one-time text message to validate the mobile number associated with your registration. Message frequency is one verification text per request. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help.

Sharing

We do not sell SMS opt-in data or share it with third parties for their marketing. We may share information with service providers that help operate registration, hosting, storage, messaging, and event workflows, subject to appropriate confidentiality and security controls.

Contact

For privacy or SMS support, contact hello@mojoaisummits.com.
